summary_zh: 在发出强风和大雨警告后，特鲁迪减弱为热带风暴，希腊造成一人死亡。与安静的大西洋飓风季节相比，太平洋地区的活动一直在持续，特鲁迪是第 22 个也是最新命名的系统。 2 级飓风仍在墨西哥海岸西南约 100 英里（160 公里）处，这意味着最恶劣的情况仍在近海。然而，美国国家飓风中心将哈利斯科州、米却肯州和科利马州的沿海地区置于飓风警告之下，预计周日的持续风速将高达 60-90 英里/小时

title_en: China’s economy grows faster than forecast after AI boom boosts exports
summary_en: Third-quarter GDP up by 4.5% compared with last year as industrial output is buoyed by electronics demand Roaring exports lifted China’s economic growth in the third quarter of this year, with factory output growing much faster than consumer spending. China’s GDP grew by 4.5% year-on-year between July and September, the National Bureau of Statistics of China reported on Monday. The figures were better than economists had expected and up from the second quarter’s growth rate of 4.3%. Continue reading...
title_zh: 人工智能热潮推动出口，中国经济增长快于预期
summary_zh: 电子产品需求提振工业产值，第三季度GDP较去年增长4.5% 今年第三季度，出口的强劲增长带动了中国经济增长，工厂产出增速远快于消费者支出。中国国家统计局周一公布，7月至9月中国GDP同比增长4.5%。该数字好于经济学家的预期，高于第二季度 4.3% 的增长率。继续阅读...

title_en: Three deaths from float crushes raise safety concerns over Japanese festivals
summary_en: Deputy mayor of Saijo died after becoming trapped under float, days after two similar incidents elsewhere There is mounting concern over the safety of Japan’s traditional festivals after the death of a senior local official who was reportedly crushed beneath a float at the weekend, days after two men died in similar incidents in another part of the country. Akihiro Nabae, the deputy mayor of Saijo, in western Japan, was carrying a giant float with other participants in a festival on Saturday when he became trapped beneath the structure, Agence France-Presse reported. Nabae, 62, was taken to ho
title_zh: 花车碾压造成三人死亡引发日本节日安全担忧
summary_zh: 西条市副市长被困在花车下身亡，几天前，其他地方也发生了两起类似事件。 据报道，周末一名地方高级官员被压在花车下死亡，几天前，日本另一个地区也发生了类似事件，导致两名男子死亡。据法新社报道，日本西部西条市副市长田惠明弘 (Akihiro Nabae) 周六在节日期间与其他参与者一起抬着一个巨大的花车，结果被困在建筑物下面。 62 岁的 Nabae 被送往医院

title_en: Amelia Earhart researchers leave remote atoll empty-handed after ‘plane debris’ found to be a clump of trees
summary_en: Expedition was drawn to Nikumaroro after spotting what was described as a metallic glint in waters off uninhabited island A US expedition that voyaged to a remote Pacific island in the hope of solving the mystery of what happened to pioneering pilot Amelia Earhart has said an object they suspected to be her plane was a clump of washed-up trees. “Unfortunately, we weren’t able to find that smoking gun,” said Steve Schultz of Purdue University, standing on the sand in front of a blue lagoon on the atoll of Nikumaroro, about halfway between Australia and Hawaii. Continue reading...
title_zh: 阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特的研究人员在发现“飞机残骸”是一丛树木后空手离开偏远环礁
summary_zh: 一支美国探险队在无人居住的岛屿附近的水域发现了所谓的金属闪光，因此被吸引到尼库马罗罗。一支美国探险队前往一个偏远的太平洋岛屿，希望解开先驱飞行员阿米莉亚·埃尔哈特的遭遇之谜，他们表示，他们怀疑是她的飞机的一个物体是一丛被冲毁的树木。 “不幸的是，我们没能找到确凿的证据，”普渡大学的史蒂夫·舒尔茨站在尼库马罗罗环礁上蓝色泻湖前的沙滩上说道，该环礁位于澳大利亚和夏威夷之间。继续阅读...

title_en: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
summary_en: Satellite images give clues about how Kim spends his holidays - something far out of reach for most North Koreans.
title_zh: 照片显示金正恩避暑胜地附近设有 50m 泳池和水滑梯的豪华游船
summary_zh: 卫星图像提供了金正恩如何度过假期的线索——这对大多数朝鲜人来说是遥不可及的。

title_en: A thousand slogans echoed here - but it could be the end for iconic Delhi protest site
summary_en: Jantar Mantar, an 18th Century site almost synonymous with demonstrations in Delhi, has been denotified as a protest site.
title_zh: 一千个口号在这里回荡——但这可能是德里标志性抗议场所的终结
summary_zh: 简塔·曼塔天文台 (Jantar Mantar) 是一处建于 18 世纪的遗址，几乎是德里示威活动的代名词，现已被认定为抗议场所。

title_en: India’s Cockroach Janta party leader arrested amid crackdown on protests
summary_en: Abhijeet Dipke was detained before planned anti-government demonstrations in Delhi The leader of the Cockroach Janta party (CJP) youth movement, Abhijeet Dipke, was detained by police on Friday and then later formally arrested as authorities cracked down on fresh anti-government protests in the Indian capital. Dipke was detained before a planned Friday evening demonstration he had called in central Delhi, urging supporters of the movement to come out and hold up the Indian flag. Continue reading...
title_zh: 印度蟑螂简塔党领导人在镇压抗议活动中被捕
summary_zh: 阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke) 在德里计划举行的反政府示威活动前被拘留 蟑螂简塔党 (CJP) 青年运动领导人阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke) 于周五被警方拘留，随后在当局镇压印度首都新的反政府抗议活动时被正式逮捕。迪普克在周五晚上计划在德里市中心举行示威活动之前被拘留，他敦促该运动的支持者站出来高举印度国旗。继续阅读...

title_en: Leading China Property Developer Reports Huge loss, in Sign of Widening Real-Estate Woes
summary_en: Troubles at Vanke raise questions about the continued spread of the property crisis and whether the Chinese state will step in.
title_zh: 中国领先的房地产开发商报告巨额亏损，房地产困境加剧
summary_zh: 万科的麻烦引发了人们对房地产危机持续蔓延以及中国政府是否会介入的疑问。

title_en: Italy Supports Saudi Arabia Joining Fighter-Jet Program, PM Meloni Says
summary_en: The U.K., Italy and Japan have already partnered on the Global Combat Air Programme, which aims to put a new stealth fighter with supersonic capability in the skies by 2035.
title_zh: 总理梅洛尼表示，意大利支持沙特阿拉伯加入战斗机计划
summary_zh: 英国、意大利和日本已经就全球空战计划展开合作，该计划的目标是到 2035 年将具有超音速能力的新型隐形战斗机送上天空。

title_en: Kim Jong Un Is Doing Everything He Can to Keep North Korea's Youth in Line
summary_en: The dictator, eager to shut out the influence of Hollywood and K-pop, has been exalting a “shock brigade” of 300,000 teens and 20-somethings drafted into flood reconstruction.
title_zh: 金正恩正在尽一切努力让朝鲜年轻人保持一致
summary_zh: 这位独裁者急于排除好莱坞和韩国流行音乐的影响，一直在赞扬一支由 30 万青少年和 20 多岁的年轻人组成的“突击队”，被征召参加洪水重建。

title_en: Germany's Economic Model Is Broken, and No One Has a Plan B
summary_en: The country is focused on exports, but China is slowing imports and U.S. tariff threats are growing. Politicians are offering few alternatives.
title_zh: 德国经济模式已被打破，没有人有备用计划
summary_zh: 该国专注于出口，但中国正在放缓进口，而美国的关税威胁正在加剧。政客们几乎没有提供任何替代方案。

title_en: Beijing Signals Readiness to Talk to Trump's Team, Even Old Foes
summary_en: The Chinese foreign minister spoke by phone with Marco Rubio, the new secretary of state who has been a critic of Beijing.
title_zh: 北京表示愿意与特朗普团队，甚至是宿敌进行对话
summary_zh: 中国外交部长与一直批评北京的新任国务卿马可·卢比奥通了电话。

title_en: Scientists film deepest ever fish on seabed off Japan
summary_en: Cruising at a depth of 8,336 meters (over 27,000 feet) just above the seabed, a young snailfish has become the deepest fish ever filmed by scientists during a probe into the abyss of the northern Pacific Ocean.
title_zh: 科学家在日本海域拍摄有史以来最深的鱼类
summary_zh: 一只小蜗牛鱼在海床上方 8,336 米（超过 27,000 英尺）的深度巡航，成为科学家在北太平洋深渊探测过程中拍摄到的最深的鱼类。

title_en: Beijing promised to 'fight back' over Taiwan leader's US visit. But this time it has more to lose
summary_en: An anticipated meeting between Taiwan's President Tsai Ing-wen and US House Speaker Kevin McCarthy in California this week has sparked concerns of a repeat of the pressure campaign China launched last year when then-Speaker Nancy Pelosi visited Taipei.
title_zh: 北京承诺将对台湾领导人访美进行“反击”。但这一次失去的更多
summary_zh: 台湾总统蔡英文和美国众议院议长凯文·麦卡锡本周将在加利福尼亚州举行会晤，这引发了人们对中国去年时任众议院议长南希·佩洛西访问台北时发起的施压行动的重演。

title_en: Micron Technology: China probes US chip maker for cybersecurity risks as tech tension escalates
summary_en: China has launched a cybersecurity probe into Micron Technology, one of America's largest memory chip makers, in apparent retaliation after US allies in Asia and Europe announced new restrictions on the sale of key technology to Beijing.
title_zh: 美光科技：随着技术紧张局势升级，中国调查美国芯片制造商的网络安全风险
summary_zh: 中国对美国最大的存储芯片制造商之一美光科技发起网络安全调查，这显然是对美国在亚洲和欧洲的盟友宣布对向北京出售关键技术实施新限制的报复。

title_en: Suspected Chinese spy balloon was able to transmit information back to Beijing
summary_en: The suspected Chinese spy balloon that transited the US earlier this year was able to capture imagery and collect some signals intelligence from US military sites, a source familiar with the matter tells CNN.
title_zh: 疑似中国间谍气球能够将信息传回北京
summary_zh: 一位知情人士告诉美国有线电视新闻网，今年早些时候飞越美国的疑似中国间谍气球能够从美国军事地点捕获图像并收集一些信号情报。

title_en: China Renaissance suspends trading, delays results after founder's disappearance
summary_en: China Renaissance, a top dealmaker in the country's tech industry, said it would suspend trading of its shares and delay the release of its annual results because it still can't get in touch with its founder.
title_zh: 创始人失踪后华兴资本暂停交易并推迟公布业绩
summary_zh: 中国科技行业最大的交易撮合者华兴资本表示，由于仍无法与其创始人取得联系，因此将暂停其股票交易并推迟发布年度业绩。
